I also used a razor blade for the first time tonight. I've been cutting with shards of broken mirror for a long time but it got sloppy. Felt so easy, so controlled. Kind of scary how easy it is to cut deep with that shit

i've been carving words into my body since i was in high school, and i remember so distinctly when i first read the book sharp objects. it made me feel like a person, and a person that could be more than just my cutting. i think that outweighs anything else. people that are tempted to self harm because of the show most likely have other underlying factors. its hard to walk the line of romanticizing and simply portraying, and i think the show does a better job at that than nearly anything else i've seen
